full_page.content:
1934, January 8
The following is a faithful transemption of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, C. F.M. Cap.
St. bonaventure Monastery 1740 Mt. Elliott Detroit, Michigan Jan. 8, 1934 God bless you Helena 10:40 PM . . . . May He direct you for the best.
Miss Helena Casey Los Angeles, California
My Dear Niece Helena: -
The New Year is still in its baby-hood: so I'll wish you all kinds of blessings before it passes as all others so far have gone. If ever I get up with my letters again I'll write to my dear ones more frequently. I hope. .. I am glad you have found someone and that someone has found you wherety mutual congeniality seems promising ..... That he is older than you is a secondary matter .... Even that he actually knows little about the True Religion might be secondary too, if only he or anyone else be desirous to learn - be willing to find out - and dispel doubts. ... It is so easy for the Church to vindicate her every Doctrine! ! ! .. . How your dear Father John was convinced of this! So much so that tho his death was tragic, it was never the less a holy death. I never worried about that ....
Fr. Solanus.
P.S. Preparing for ... Speed up your communions.
